narr: An upper level low was located over northern GA with shortwave energy rotating through the base of the trough. Moderate instability and a moist air mass was present with precipitable water values around 1.8 inches. Scattered storms continued into the overnight hours and trained over areas that had already received heavy rains.
ev: Devils Backbone Rd, where it crosses Caney Branch, was flooded. Water entered a nearby home where residents were forced to evacuate.
